title: Help & quality reports
description: A short guide and a way to report problem questions without leaking the full assessment content.

generate.title: Generate a draft
generate.body: Fill in the source and configuration, then follow the job progress. The draft still needs teacher review.

review.title: Review questions
review.body: Use quick mode for the list, detail mode to edit question by question. Finalizing needs a separate confirmation.

output.title: Output & share
output.body: Printing and downloading use the same artifact. A share link can be revoked at any time.

privacy.title: Source privacy
privacy.body: Private PDFs are processed for the draft. Do not upload sensitive data you do not need.

report.title: Report a problem question
report.description: Send the reference ID plus the reason. Avoid pasting the full stem/options when it is not necessary.
report.notePlaceholder: Describe the problem briefly without sensitive data.

status.sent: Report received ({reportId}). The question content was not sent in full.
status.failed: The report could not be sent.
status.offline: Could not connect. Please try again.
